reviews.text: Great experience, brought my turtle here to get looked at and the team was very responsive and helpful.

I have had all of my birds treated at this office and have never had anything but a perfect experience. The staff are so genuinely invested in the health and happiness of my pets, I am very grateful for the care I have received here <3

Very knowledgeable and friendly team but they need to work on listening to their clients. I came in because my bunny had a case of pasteurella (which was diagnosed by a different vet before I adopted her) and was given spotty treatments of an antibiotic and wasn’t responding to it. This is a classic case of antibiotic resistance. I told the vet my suspicions multiple times but they insisted on continuing with the same antibiotic plus three other unnecessary (and expensive) medications that didn’t do anything to improve her condition. I had to come in every two weeks for months and pay almost 600 dollars EACH VISIT for them to continue with this same ineffective treatment. Additionally they insisted they needed to run a 1,000 dollar culture (which I repeatedly refused) because the previous culture was not conducted by their clinic. I ended up stop booking appointments because the treatment clearly wasn’t working, I wasn’t being heard and I was emptying my wallet. I ended up going to a different exotic vet and explained the situation and that I thought my bunny was resistant to the antibiotic she kept receiving. This vet immediately prescribed a different one, and the pasteurella immediately cleared after less than two weeks of this treatment. It also only cost 300 bucks for the treatment plus a full checkup. To the vet team, please learn from this feedback and listen to what the clients have to say!

They were really receptive from the phone call to processing us and getting us seen immediately. They were very attentive to us and provided so much information and care as well as next steps followed by reaching out to us to confirm all is well.
They've been incredibly helpful with getting my turtle's health back on track. Such a compassionate and knowledgeable staff that are truly looking out for your pets wellbeing.

This place and staff are amazing, my Amazon parrot had a medical event that needed asap care. They took the time to properly diagnose and verify a cardiac event and got him back on track. Excellent bedside manor and educating proper care for moving forward.
Very impressed with the amount of communication I got from doctor Daysen.

We have been with Dr. Tyson since 2021. There is noone else around that gives the amount of kind, compassionate and techincal care as her and her team. We are so lucky to have them. I have no doubts my Sammy is loved beyond measure in their care. 🖤 We will never see anyone else. …

an amazing place to bring your exotics! I drive 3 hours just to visit with my reptiles when they need it. I have always received top notch care, clear and concise payment options and billing costs, they are excellent at breaking everything down and staying within budget when possible. I have had a recent string of bad luck with some wild caught specimens and the vets went above and beyond for me and those babies, especially Dr. W (  abbreviated ) the techs are as amazing as the vets. I have been working in the field for decades and I havent come across such competent vets in so long I want to cry in relief. The ONY complaint I have is that I dont live closer haha!! They are THE BEST place for reptiles - as someone who has BEEN to every single reptile and "exotic" vet in Pennsylvania. you wil not find anyone more qualified to care for your babies. And for when the team see's this, Aith says hi!!!! she doesnt miss you hahaha!!

I had to help my rabbit go over the rainbow bridge. The staff was beyond kind and considerate. I had never even been there before. It really helped made it easier. Would recommend a million times over.
They have always taken wonderful care of my guinea pigs. The vets and nurses are extremely knowledgeable and kind.
Followed Doc Dazen there who has been my African Grey Molly's vet for a very long time. Everyone was very friendly.

Susan Tyson is a great vet! She and her staff really know what they are doing. My 5 year old beardie was not feeling well, but they figured out what's going on and prescribed the right medications. If you care about your pet and are willing to spend the money to make sure they are getting proper care, this is the place to go to for your reptiles, birds, and amphibians. Vanessa, Alexis, Evan, Herbie, Sierra-Rose, Toni, Tom, Amy (and anyone else I forgot to mention) thank you all very much!
treated my leopard gecko, Hank,  very well. I thought he was going to pass away. but after treating the infection as recommended by our vet, Hank is thriving again. well worth the visit! thank you

I’m rather selective about what vet office my cockatiel Fig goes to after some experiences at places that claim they handle avian care but don’t specialize. I don’t think Fig will ever go to a different vet after our amazing experiences at Avian & Exotic Philly! Everyone in the office genuinely cares about any animal that comes through their door, and they are thorough at explaining procedures, cost estimates, and answering any questions. The price is more than reasonable for the high level of care received from the team.
Thank you Dr. Tyson, Dr. Wilhelm, and all the support staff (especially Sierra Rose from the front desk)!
I took my conure in to get examined yesterday. Everyone there clearly knows how to handle birds and the office was very clean!!!

After struggling to find a vet for our snapping turtle we found this place. We saw Dr Katrina for our snapping Turtle Leo who was getting an infection. She & the staff were super nice & helpful. I learned Dr Kat has alot of snapping tirtle experience witch was very relieving. The staff completely light up seeing our Leo & was genuinely excited to have him there. They would do weekly check up over the phone, They wrote his name on the door in a fancy way & everything. They truly love what they do there. It may have taken a few visits to find out what was wrong however after an x-ray ray it was clear & he was just eating sand witch we got rid of in his tank. Dr Kat is amazing & words cannot due justice of how thankful we are to find her! She saves our boys life! Thank you guys again.

My rabbit Basil entered G.I. Stasis and had a blockage, after a 24hr hospitalization at another vet we transferred her care to Avian. Avian was able to determine a few possible root causes of her critical state, as well as what we can do to treat those issues. I cannot say enough good things about Dr.Wilhelm, Dr.Tyson, Claire, and the rest of the supportive staff there. I learned more about Basil and her current state of health in a few hours than I have in our yearly visits the last 6 years at our other vet. They are committed to education, compassion, and integrity regarding the care of your pet. Thanks to the ongoing crucial and life saving care provided by Avian, I can proudly say my sweet girl is headed in the right direction and home with me. Thank you all endlessly.
Thanks Jennifer! We try as hard as we can to keep costs low without sacrificing quality of care. ♥️

I have taken my 7-year-old American Toad Rocky to other vets for various reasons, but within the past four months, he has been suffering from a swollen eye, obtained from a fall back in August, but had been noticed, but never addressed, being told it will take time to heal. Friday afternoon Rocky had a discharge from his eye, and I tried to get him in to see the vet at his usual vet's office and was told that he couldn't be seen until Monday. I was referred to Avian & Exotic Philly Vet Medical Surgical Clinic by my twin sister, so I decided to give them a call last Friday. They were able to see Rocky the next morning! We were greeted by the friendliest staff, then Dr. Hussein. Rocky has never before had such an extensive exam, consisting of radiographs, Intraocular pressure, fluorescein stain of the cornea, and was diagnosed with glaucoma in his left eye and other health related issues causing him to not want to eat. He was given injections, which I will continue to administer daily, and if by one week there doesn't seem to be any sign of improvement, his eye may have to be removed. I am so thankful to the expertise of care that my little Rocky received and will continue his journey with the practice.

My little Pierre’s love of shiny things became a huge issue when I noticed an earring go missing recently. After turning the house upside down looking for it, I became suspicious that it had fallen on the floor and was found by my little buddy. X-rays confirmed that he had not swallowed one, but TWO earrings, one I had never even noticed had gone missing. Both had traveled to his gizzard and my normal exotic vet was not comfortable with trying to remove them. She recommended Dr. Tyson as the one for the job.

In spite of being one of the scariest times I’ve ever experienced with an animal thanks to my unfortunate habit of googling, Dr. Tyson was able to remove the items from my little stinker’s tummy and he has been recovering phenomenally. They kept me updated constantly during his stay via phone calls and texts which kept my mind at ease through the whole process.

I could never thank you guys enough for getting my baby boy all fixed up. He still has another 10 days before his sutures can be removed, but I am confident he will make a perfect recovery. ❤️‍🩹

And to anyone wondering, the jewelry box has been relocated to another part of the house in case of any accidental drops and my choice in ear hardware has been changed to much more secure pieces. 😅

THANK YOU SO MUCH!! I don’t know where we’d be without you guys.
Thank you for the review! ♥️

They treat my bunny with so much love, they were really nice too
Love it I really recommend this place
Amazing staff

My African Grey had seizures at home, and I was referred to Dr Tyson by my vet. She received TOP NOTCH care by all the staff. They found multiple health concerns, and I spent several hours there as they cared for her. The staff is comforting and upfront about my expectations. I was the last patient (late as a matter of fact) and never felt rushed. Kudos to AEPV.

I can not say enough amazing things about everything and everyone! The staff creates a warm and welcoming environment that is unmatched. I love the open concept clinic, everyone is transparent with treatments, cost, and anything you might be concerned about. I have never met such friendly people, I know my pets health are in the right hands! Shoutout to Katie, Dr.Hussein, and Alexis for being so awesome!!! Totally worth the 1hr drive, I’d do it a million times for our babies!

A heartfelt 10/10 Experience🌿
This was our very first visit to Avion & Exotic Philly Vet Surgical Clinic, and I can truly say this place has earned a special spot in our hearts. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with such a warm and welcoming ambiance. The staff was friendly, kind, professional, and incredibly attentive.

They treated our two beautiful bunnies with so much gentleness and care, taking the time to explain everything clearly and making sure we understood their needs. The communication was excellent, and you can genuinely feel how much they love and respect the animals they care for.

The Clinic itself is immaculate, bright, and beautifully organized- filled with natural light and lovely plants (which I personally adore!). It's such a calm and positive environment, and that energy truly makes a difference. Thank you to Alexis (Head Nurse), Sierrarose (who warmly greeted us), there was another young lady whose name i can't remember but she had some purple haircolor on her ends I do remember that. Thank you for making us feel so comfortable, informed, and welcome. You all went above and beyond, and we're grateful for the love and care you showed to our Buns.

If you have any Exotic pets, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this Clinic. They deserve ten stars in our eyes.
My 3 experiences with my canary Elvis has always very good!! Everyone is always caring, ,understanding and have great compassion. Highly recommend taking your pets here.
Thank you so much for the five star review! ♥️

Hi! I am the peasant (owner) of @LEMONTHELOP! (:
I am that overly crazy bunny mom that revolutionized the “free the buns” movement back in 2018. I’ve spent years educating rabbit owners on ALL things BUN all over the world for 7 years now and one thing everyone knows about me is that I take Lem’s care & health VERY seriously!! With that in mind, I’ve also always struggled with WHO to trust Lemon with as far as a DVM goes. It took me a year or so to find his last DVM and she has been nothing shy of a blessing in our lives. As you may already know, rabbits should not go under anesthesia UNLESS absolutely necessary & I can honestly say, I prefer to stay away from it at all costs. Anyway, LEM became critically ill 3 weeks ago and I had no option but to take him into a vet. Our trusted vet is out in Utah. So, I did my research and landed here. I took Lem in and Dr. Amy was nothing short of kind, attentive & caring. Does she have my full trust? Nope, not yet. That will come with time. However, what I can say is that they called me the next day to check in on him and even a week later. They emailed me in detail and they walked me through everything while I was in the office. I also LOVED that they gave me a pamphlet on where to get insurance for exotics!!! Something I’ve always wanted and never had access to. Before going in for the visit, I was afraid Lem wouldn’t make it to see his 7th Birthday and now he’s already celebrated and he’s finally turning a corner. THANK YOU for helping us and we look forward to scheduling a follow up visit with you guys!!
With love,
LEMONTHELOP
The place is very welcoming, and the staff is extremely helpful. Honestly, I couldn’t recommend a better place to take your pet when they’re feeling sick.

Thank you "Am I Impressed" :D

I guess you were impressed enough to give us five stars which, as a small business, we appreciate so much! ♥️

I first came to Dr. Tyson from the recommendation of a receptionist at Queen Village Animal Hospital (who I go to for my cats). I had been taking my leopard gecko, Togo, to another vet for a while for health issues related to her eyes and was looking for a second opinion. Within Togo’s first visit with Dr. Tyson, I was sold that she was the vet for her. She and her staff are incredibly kind and treated Togo with such love and care, as if she was a part of their family. She helped with diagnosing Togo with corneal ulcers due to a vitamin deficiency and getting her the care she needed.
Unfortunately, as I write this, we lost our lovely Togo girl earlier this evening. Looking back on her amazing life, I’m so grateful for the incredible care they gave us. I couldn’t have asked for a better team to take her to. Thank you so much to you all.

Don’t make an appointment for Monday or Tuesday. Wanted to have my faithful parrot Oliver’s wings clipped beak and claws. No wing clippings here! But was told complementary trimming of claws included in $125.00 annual wellness check! Booked the appointment. Now I started to feeling ill on Friday and was down with whatever called at opening Monday to reschedule, with a faster response than we don’t trim wings here! Was told look at your receipt, clearly stated NO REFUND on cancellation with in 48 hours of appointment!! This place is closed Saturday and Sunday, impossible to change with in 48 hours. So I am out 125, ok I get it.  So thanks to a police officer who visited with Oliver and I on our daily walk, health permitting, lol I was given a tip, check out the suburbs for more options. I have and thankfully for Oliver we located pet store that offers walk in’s no appointments needed, and can provide all services wanted for your pet! So thanks for nothing enjoy the 125.

Dr. Tyson is, without a doubt, the most competent veterinarian and, quite possibly, the most compassionate human being that I have ever met. She cares deeply about what she does and the lives she touches, and she knows exactly what she is doing when it comes to providing exceptional veterinary medical care. Her incredible skill, expertise, and genuine empathy likely saved my rabbit's life and, in turn, saved my whole little world. She goes above and beyond to take care of her patients; her team is an amazing, well-oiled machine that works together seamlessly, and the strong ethical commitment that she has toward treating every animal is evident as soon as you see her in action. If I could give this review a thousand stars, I would. I will forever be grateful for all that she has done for my Bunny.
Everyone was friendly, caring, and made us and our bird Bonnie comfortable.
Brought my French Bulldog to the City Wide Veterinary Rehabilitation which is ran out of there. So far they have been great. A+ experience.

I was able to get a same day appointment for my hamster who was in some serious need of care. Other exotic vets in the area were fully booked, so I’m glad my hamster could be seen here. Staff are all very kind, the vets seem very well versed in exotics, and their prices are very affordable for the patients they see.

What a ripoff! This vet charges an OUTRAGEOUS amount of money and doesn't care about the patient. They over prescribe, over test, and get offended when you ask questions about your own pet's health! They literally put my pet on four medications including antibiotics without doing a SINGLE lab test or having ANY indication that he had an infection.

Moreover, on my first visit the normal vet wasn't on duty so there was a substitute vet. The substitute was late by an hour, admittedly said they they didn't know as much about my species of pet, and was extremely slow. I was at the vet for 3 HOURS for a physical exam. Then they charged me FULL PRICE even though they were late, slow, and the normal vet wasn't on duty. Staff never informed me that the vet was a substitute or would be late.

Meanwhile, I've been to another exotic vet with over 30 years experience. That vet did the procedure for 1/6 the price, took my pet off all the ridiculous cocktail of drugs, and now he is happy and healthy. Goes to show that Avian & Exotic Philly Medical Surgical Clinic ONLY cares about how much money they can scam from you.
Knowledgeable and empathetic staff. Highly recommend them for your exotic pet needs!

I didn't want to write this; this is the first bad review I've ever written, but it would actually weigh on my conscience to not warn others and describe my experience.

Avian & Exotic Philly Vet Medical Surgical Clinic, despite the catchy name, caused me so much more trouble than a good vet ever would. They acknowledged their mutiple mistakes, yet refused to rectify them. They withheld important information, risked my pets' health, and outright lied to me.

I know I shouldn't recommend a competitor in a review, but I will anyway: anyone else.

I'll just tell you what I went through regarding my rats mild respiratory infection. Maybe you can make a more informed decision when deciding who to trust with your pets.

To start, they called me about 2 hours before asking me to come in an hour early for nebulization. Astounded by the sheer professionalism and scheduling proficiency, I headed over. I asked if there were any risks. They said no, there are none at all. Then someone else came, took a look at her, and said it wouldn't be worth it, due to the risks. Bruh.

Then they started the exam in the middle of the main room (the open area surrounded by animals in cages and with a straight shot to the front door). It was so loud it was difficult to hear the nurses. I asked if they had a private room available, and they said no. It's quarantined due to an infection. I'm sure profit had nothing to do with withholding that info.

I offered to hold her while they examined her because she was so scared of that environment. I decided to trust them (I am not smart). She immediately jumped out of their arms and straight to the floor. Luckily we were able to get her back before she made it into one of the many dangerous spots (like the mouth of that reptile), or even straight outside through the mail slot.

Shortly before I left, I saw someone set up a phone to record the entire thing. To be fair, if they had asked, I would've been happy to decline.

When it came time to pay I found out they kept all my credit card information (number, full name, date, ccv) from the "deposit" (full cost of the exam) That is a risky practice, and the fact that they wouldn't even schedule without money in their hand should have of warned me of what happened next.

They prescribed a 21 day supply of antibiotics. Thankfully I thought to check the dates, because I saw one of them expired after 12 days. I was absolutely not informed of that, which they admitted to. If I didn't notice, I would have been giving her ineffective meds at best.

After politely attempting to deceive me, they explained that they make it in batches, and they gave me one from an older batch. I still have to pay for a new bottle, and it'll be ~$33. Even though it's their mistake.
I asked if they could give a discount or waive it. They called back and said there's nothing they can do. But they did adjust the price. It's now over $40.
I asked if they could write me a prescription so that I could get it from a different vet.
They eventually refused, and surprise! It's actually $52 now. I asked to speak to management. They said they would ask.
Management courageously refused to talk to me, but they did count their change, and offered 15% discount off of the $52.

When I go to pick it up I'm told it's $54. That seemed like a weird discount to me, so despite warnings from my phenomenal pattern recognition, I asked them to look into it again. Somehow, and this part still amazes me, they managed not to raise the price again! (besides the surprise 4% admin fee).
Sure, the recept says 32+2-15% = 46 but that's just your typical invisible and unexplainable numbers on an invoice that change every time you call.

So credit where it's due: Thank you very much to the AEPVMSC team for that. Your hard work, compassion, and unrivaled commitment to your clients helped me to only have to pay a lot of money due to your incompetence <3. The stress of everything was well worth it considering your terrible care for my sweet little rat. I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone and everyone I hate!

This place is amazing. The doctors know what they are talking about and care deeply about the animals they see. I have taken my rats here for oxygen (and they took the time to help me plan at- home nebulization as well), when my little rat had a paint chip in her eye, and for other care. Friendly, let you sit with your pet in the back, and work with you for payment. A little expensive but they have plan options. After my rat passed away they even sent a card to my home.

Dr. Tyson and the Avian Exotics team are the absolute best. You can tell they really care about the animals and work hard to ensure that the best decision is made. Writing this review a bit late but I had to put my pet hedgehog down and the team were incredible in ensuring that I received adequate information and walking me through the process. It was rough but ultimately, the most humane decision because she was suffering. They let me stay there with her at her last moments too and were even kind enough to send a signed condolences card, which was so sweet. It was hard revisiting this but I feel like l needed to let everyone how amazing this place is. If you have an exotic pet that needs care, this is the place to go. Thank you once again Avian Exotics team.

Today was the hardest day we had as a reptile family. Our sweet boy Raspberry became very ill and the staff here was so kind and supportive while we processed the news. Although our little chameleon won't be returning home, I'm at peace knowing his transition was in the loving hands of this office.
Incredible team! Everyone was deeply knowledgeable and genuinely supportive. They offered a wealth of education and resources that made a real difference.

Compassionate staff,highly skilled and knowledgeable in the care of all species of animals.They are also adept at making pet owners feel comfortable and secure in the knowledge that their animals are receiving the highest level of treatment.It is comforting to know that people who care this much about animals still exist in the world.

Highly recommend for bird owners!! I have a unique situation with a 3 week old baby bourke parakeet and they were incredibly helpful and kind throughout the whole visit. I am amazed by the care they gave and how knowledgeable they were. It’s difficult finding avian vets, but I don’t mind making the long drive to come here for great care! Everyone was so inviting and reassuring. Thank you so much to the whole team/staff.

Everyone was very professional.  Dr. P appeared to be extremely knowledgeable.  She treated my birds very gently but firmly,  Her nurse was also very attentive and informative.  My experience was extremely positive.
The meeting will start the next day, it's rare, I'm glad I came with a bearded Dragon

They never stated anything about $130 deposit that I lost because I was late before I made the appointment. It would’ve been nice to know that before I made the appointment. I just wanted a regular check up that never happened and I was a new patient.
Absolutely awesome!! Took our beardie in and they were amazing. They truly care. They provided us with a lot of guidance to address our concerns.
Very sensitive and caring nurses and doctor! Our Gecko was surrounded by love and maximum care! The staff did everything to help! Thank you very much!

I seriously can’t praise this place enough. The entire staff is incredible and welcoming. I brought my ball python recently and was treated like a queen. So happy an avian and exotics vet exists in the city! Highly recommend!

I took my pet pigeon here, Winter. Now the visit went well, everyone is super nice, it just seems like more is known about parrots then about pigeons which makes sense. I also liked how I was able to pay based on a budget. Thank you!!
Been bringing our cockatiel here for almost 2 years and the level of care and compassion is top notch. The Drs, nurse, techs are all avid animal lovers and it shows. Highly recommend

Would 100% recommend Avian & Exotic to any and all bird owners. I brought my two budgies for a check up and blood work and they were so kind and professional, taking the time to walk me through everything they were doing and why. I learned so much! Feeling very lucky to have such an excellent clinic right in Philly.
Exceeded my expectations during a difficult time.

Look no further, this is by far the most kind, compassionate, attentive and educated staff I have ever dealt with in my past 50+ years.
When our African Grey parrot died suddenly we needed a business that would provide a necropsy and pathology test within 24 hours of passing.  We were given the name of this business (Avian & Exotic Philly) by a local vet in the Lehigh Valley area.  We drove the hour and a half to Avian & Exotic Philly Vet Clinic.  The staff went ABOVE and BEYOND to make our experience as comfortable and painless as possible.   Every question was answered extensively, and we had many.
Our only regret is not knowing this business existed prior to our beloved parrot's passing.  Please don't hesitate to make them your number one vet clinic.

I cannot recommend Dr. Tyson enough! She is knowledgeable, kind, and dedicated to her patients in a way I think very few vets are.

We keep pet rats, and Dr. Tyson has been so great to them. She always gives them snuggles and takes pictures together when I bring them in.

About a week ago, one of our girls went into respiratory distress and I brought her in for help. They made time for me for a same-day appointment and gave our little Pancake oxygen support. As the day came to a close, our girl still needed oxygen, and would need to be admitted to a hospital overnight, costing us a small fortune. Instead of sending us to the hospital, Dr. Tyson helped us find an oxygen condenser for ourselves and waited in the office long after it closed so that we could take Pancake home instead. She stayed well after dinner time on a Friday evening just to be kind.

Especially for pocket pets, and rats in particular, I think people are not always able or willing to see them as quite as important as cats or dogs. Having a vet who really went out of her way in a moment where we needed help made all the difference.  I will always be grateful to Dr. Tyson for her kindness and support that day. If you've got a bird or a pocket pet- run, don't walk, to this practice!
Very efficient and knowledgeable! Friendly staff/environment.

Dr. Tyson is the absolute best exotics vet we've ever had. After moving 400 miles away from Philly for work, we--no kidding--still do virtual appointments with her because she's THAT good with bunnies. Beyond her excellent care for your pet, she also spends time with the humans educating you on what to look out for healthwise. Five stars aren’t enough to do this review justice.

I LOVE LITERALLY EVERY SINGLE PERSON WHO WORKS HERE!!!! I have been in and out of here since October (now January) for chelation for metal toxicity. I have been helped by both Dr. Tyson and Dr. Bocchine and all nurses at this point. These people know what they are doing, and they care SO MUCH. They take every concern seriously, which my last vet failed to do. Their exams are extremely thorough and check for things I never knew needed to be checked. To further, they handle my birds as comfortable for them as possible (without a towel). Most vets will be stubborn about procedure, but the staff here optimizes pet experience. They do everything AND MORE to help your pets. They love my birdies (Opal and Frankie) and know them by name. They love to sing to them and even give them scratches/pets! When Frankie had to stay over night, I was given pictures and updates by staff without even asking!!!

They were able to give me information and resources to optimize my birds health (UVB lamp, heat lamp, VetOmega, Calcium powder, diet/pellet suggestions, and so much more). None of which was suggested previous vets.

I am always welcomed with a big smile and always feel welcomed. I always end up staying a while since I love to chitchat with the staff. They care about me just as much as they care about my babies. I also love how they refer me as "Mom" because these birds are my children!! I wish I could give a million stars!!!!!
Excellent Doctor(Susan Tyson) and Staff!!! They do everything possible to make sure my pet is comfortable, calm  and receives all the care that is needed. A++++

I had a great experience bringing my Red-tailed Hawk in here for an appointment after he got an eye injury. Everyone on staff was so kind, respectful, knowledgeable, and communicative. To help minimize potentially stressful handling time for my hawk, the veterinary team walked me through the plan for the exam and diagnostic tests upfront before the start of the exam, which I really appreciated. Dr. Bocchine even allowed me (and encouraged me) to restrain my bird myself and to watch up close and ask questions during the entire exam. Dr. Bocchine and the rest of the veterinary team were very knowledgeable and thorough in answering my questions and addressing my concerns, and they even talked me through other aspects of my hawk's health that were unrelated to the injury, such as discussing potential further treatment for endoparasites. I felt so reassured by the care my hawk received.

Teddy was seen for the first time here after his visit to VEG. The nurse, doctor, and staff were super welcoming at our visit. The staff were all saying hi and playing with Teddy which made him super comfortable!!! If you have a hamster or another small animal I would definitely recommend bringing them here!
Friendly and competitive staff, really make me feel confidence
So kind and knowledgeable! The vet and her team are very thorough and supportive :)

Dr. Tyson, Ashlan, and Alexis are amazing!!! All of the staff treated my pet, Phoebe, with extreme compassion and care <3

I feel empowered to care for my pet after such an informative and thorough visit. Thank you AEPV team!

Full of regret taking my aquatic turtle here, his condition has gotten much worse after his visit. When I arrived the staff thought I made an appt for a sea turtle and said they were prepared to take him from me.. they could’ve honestly …
Staff was very kind and professional.
At this very difficult time, the doctor and her team showed my furr babies and I the most compassionate and personal care.
